title: Real Computation or Merely Naming? A Pre-Registered Mechanism Audit of 25 Cognitive-Architecture Modules in an LLM-Based Agent System
title_zh: 真实计算还是仅仅命名？对一个基于LLM的智能体系统中25个认知架构模块的预注册机制审计

paragraphs.en: Context: Agent systems built on local large language models are increasingly marketed through the vocabulary of cognitive architecture: modules named global workspace , theory of mind , causal reasoning , or active inference are listed as features, and the presence of the name is taken as the presence of the mechanism. Objectives: We ask the prior question – does the named computation actually happen – and contribute a transferable software-verification method for the claim–implementation gap: a four-question static audit protocol with line-number evidence and call-chain tracing, applicable in principle to any component whose documentation speaks in mechanism names and demonstrated here on two systems. Methods: We audit a system of this class whose documentation claims 25 cognitive mechanisms, pre-register falsifiable predictions for 11 modules and execute the corresponding interventions, replicate the protocol on the IIT- ϕ \phi core of a second, independent system that pre-commits to its own falsification criteria (one failure class, one module deep), and run two repair experiments as positive controls. Results: In 18 of 25 modules the computed value never reaches any production output; seven cross-cutting findings include three idle-wiring shapes new to the dead-code and code-smell literatures we survey ( connected-but-never-called , called-but-inert , called-but-content-blind ). Of 61 frozen criteria across 12 interventions, 53 were confirmed, two partially adjudicated, five falsified, and one adjudication-ambiguous. The repairs raised planner task success from 0.028 to 1.000 and cut state-controller error by 52%. Conclusion: Module names and module computations must be audited as independent claims. The protocol and the five-class failure taxonomy are reusable as a verification method for the claim–implementation gap, demonstrated at two-system, case-level depth; the three idle-wiring shapes are architecture-defect patterns that reach beyond cognitive-architecture vocabulary.
paragraphs.zh: 背景：基于本地大语言模型的智能体系统日益通过认知架构的词汇进行营销：被命名为全局工作空间、心智理论、因果推理或主动推理的模块被列为特性，而名称的存在被视为机制的存在。 目标：我们提出先行问题——被命名的计算是否真的发生——并针对「声明—实现」差距贡献一种可迁移的软件验证方法：一个包含四个问题的静态审计协议，附带行号证据与调用链追踪，原则上适用于任何以机制名称进行描述的组件，并在此通过两个系统进行演示。 方法：我们审计了一个此类系统，其文档声称拥有 25 种认知机制；我们为 11 个模块预先登记可证伪的预测并执行相应的干预；在一个预先承诺自身证伪标准的第二个独立系统的 IIT- ϕ \phi 核心上复现该协议（一类失败、深达一个模块）；并运行两个修复实验作为阳性对照。 结果：在 25 个模块中有 18 个模块，其计算值从未到达任何生产输出；七项横切发现包括三种我们所综述的死代码与代码异味文献中未曾出现过的闲置接线形态（connected-but-never-called、called-but-inert、called-but-content-blind）。 在 12 次干预的 61 项冻结判据中，53 项得到确认，2 项被部分裁决，5 项被证伪，1 项裁决结果不明确。 修复使规划器任务成功率从 0.028 提升至 1.000，并将状态控制器错误降低了 52%。 结论：模块名称与模块计算必须作为独立的声明分别加以审计。 该协议与五类失败分类法可作为针对「声明—实现」差距的验证方法重复使用，并在两个系统、案例级深度上得到演示；三种闲置接线形态是超越认知架构词汇的架构缺陷模式。

paragraphs.en: Agent systems built on local large language models are increasingly described using the vocabulary of cognitive science. The substrate is real: code-generating models [ 1 ] plugged into tool-use, reflection, and role-playing loops [ 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] produce systems whose documented failure modes, including hallucination [ 7 ] , are as well known as their capabilities. A repository announces a global workspace for consciousness, a theory-of-mind module, a dopamine system for reward prediction, a causal reasoning engine, and a least-action planner . The rhetorical force of these names is considerable: they suggest that decades of cognitive science have been operationalized in software. The engineering reality, however, is rarely examined. A name can be attached to a keyword counter, a constant, or to code that is never called; the claim and the computation are logically independent, and only the second can do work. Even self-correction machinery, one of the field’s standard answers to LLM unreliability, does not by itself repair reasoning errors [ 8 ] .

paragraphs.en: This paper is an audit of that gap. The audit doubles as a software-verification method for the claim–implementation gap – four checkable questions per module, line-number evidence, call-chain and value-to-output tracing, a static complement to test-based verification [ 9 ] – and its failure shapes, modules that are called yet contribute nothing to the output, are architecture-defect patterns relevant to dead-code analysis and integration testing, not facts about one repository. Our object system is a member of this class: an open repository that couples a shell of 25 named cognitive modules to an LLM-based kernel, with documentation that presents the mechanism names as capabilities (its own position paper lists “causal reasoning expert” among its core innovations). We make no statistical sampling claim: the audit treats the repository as an instance of the class, and transfer is probed by the cross-system check of Section 8 . We ask, for each module, a question that is mechanically checkable: is there real computation behind the name, and does its value reach the output?
paragraphs.zh: 本文就是对这一差距的一次审计。 这项审计兼作针对“声明–实现差距”的软件验证方法——每个模块四个可检验问题、带行号证据、调用链与取值到输出的追踪，是基于测试的验证 [ 9 ] 的静态补充——其失败形态，即被调用却对输出毫无贡献的模块，是与死代码分析和集成测试相关的架构缺陷模式，而非关于某一个代码仓库的事实。 我们的对象系统属于这一类：一个开放代码仓库，它将 25 个命名认知模块的外壳与基于 LLM 的内核耦合在一起，而文档却将这些机制名称呈现为能力（其自身的立场论文将“因果推理专家”列为核心创新之一）。 我们不做出任何统计抽样意义上的论断：该审计将此代码仓库视为该类的一个实例，而可迁移性则通过第 8 节的跨系统检查加以探究。 对每个模块，我们提出一个可机械检验的问题：名称背后是否存在真实的计算，且其取值是否到达输出？

paragraphs.en: Two prior studies in this line developed and applied the methodology. A companion audit of an emergence-marker battery [ 10 ] showed that “emergence” claims in agent systems can be falsified by random-autonomy controls; an audit of a neurotransmitter-style modulator [ 11 ] showed that a single einsum-level defect can render an entire claimed mechanism inert while the code remains importable and executable. The present study generalizes from single mechanisms to a whole architecture, and adds two elements neither prior study had: a system-scale taxonomy of failure classes, and positive controls – modules that fail the static audit but succeed after repair, demonstrating that the audit distinguishes broken implementations from unimplementable claims.
paragraphs.zh: 该方向的先前两项研究开发并应用了该方法学。 对一组涌现标记的配套审计[10]表明，智能体系统中关于“涌现”的声明可以被随机自主性对照所证伪；对一种神经递质式调制剂的审计[11]表明，单个 einsum 级别的缺陷即可使整个所声称的机制失效，而代码仍可导入并可执行。 本研究从单一机制推广到整个架构，并增加了先前两项研究都不具备的两个要素：一个系统规模的失效类别分类法，以及阳性对照——即未通过静态审计但在修复后成功的模块，这表明该审计能够区分有缺陷的实现与无法实现的声明。

The contribution is quantification, pre-registration, and a reusable protocol – the same three values that motivated the companion audits [ 10 , 11 ] : (i) a four-question static audit applied to all 25 modules with line-number evidence; (ii) 12 pre-registered intervention experiments with 61 frozen criteria, executed before any intervention data were collected; (iii) a five-class taxonomy of mechanism failure with distinct repair prospects, supported by two repair experiments and by one cross-system replication (one class, one module deep) on the IIT core of a second architecture; and (iv) seven cross-cutting findings about how naming decouples from computation in this system class, including three idle-wiring shapes that, to our knowledge, have not been catalogued in the dead-code and code-smell literature we survey.

paragraphs.en: Audits of specific mechanisms. The emergence-marker battery audit [ 10 ] tested four “emergence verification” claims with pre-registered controls and found none survived a random-autonomy baseline. The modulator audit [ 11 ] pre-registered a causal test of a neurotransmitter-style attention modulator and located a single defect that severed all influence on the output. Both studies argued that the value of such audits lies in rigor and protocol, not in the surprise of the findings; we adopt that position and scale it from one mechanism to an architecture.

paragraphs.en: Harness-performance measurement. Two concurrent benchmark efforts evaluate execution harnesses at the performance layer: a five-measure framework attributing benchmark scores between models and harnesses across 52,168 trajectories [ 15 ] , and a seven-component reliability benchmark with run-level failure attribution across 3,420 runs [ 16 ] . Both ask how well the machinery performs once it exists; the present audit asks whether the named machinery exists at all and whether its computed value ever reaches an output (Section 4 ). The layer difference has five concrete consequences. (i) Existence versus performance: a called-but-inert module executes on every trajectory, spends tokens on every run, and is scored by task-level metrics as working infrastructure, yet contributes nothing to the answer; establishing the absence of causal effect at component granularity requires tracing the code path itself, without a trajectory corpus. (ii) A defect vocabulary that performance measurement does not possess: the three idle-wiring shapes (connected-but-never-called, called-but-inert, called-but-content-blind) and the four-question protocol that surfaces them (Section 3 ) are addressed to module-internal wiring, which run-level scoring does not inspect. (iii) A different unit of analysis: the audited objects are module-level mechanism claims carried by cognitive-architecture vocabulary (global workspace, theory of mind, active inference), not run-level harness components; to our knowledge, no audit of this class exists. (iv) Falsification structure: 61 frozen criteria with five falsified and reported as such, a second system replicating the protocol under its own pre-committed criteria (Section 8 ), and repair experiments as positive controls; as presented, the two benchmarks center run-level scoring rather than pre-registered mechanism falsification, and the two structures are complementary. (v) Attribution semantics: their failure attribution assigns a failed run to a component; ours assigns causal contribution to a module and separates naming from computation.

paragraphs.en: Global workspace theory and its imitations. Global workspace theory [ 17 , 18 ] posits a broadcast architecture in which module contents compete for access to a limited-capacity workspace whose winning content is broadcast to all consumers. The theory makes functional commitments – content sensitivity, competition, broadcast – that are testable in software. Systems that implement only the name (a salience table plus an argmax) inherit none of these commitments; Section 5 shows what a pre-registered test of those commitments looks like.

paragraphs.en: Reproducibility and artifact evaluation. The recurring failure to reproduce published systems research [ 19 , 20 ] and the credibility crisis it exposed [ 21 , 22 ] motivated preregistration reform [ 23 , 24 ] , leakage-aware reproducibility standards [ 25 ] , artifact badging, and reproducibility checklists [ 26 , 27 ] . Those processes ask whether claimed results recompute; the present audit asks a prior question, whether claimed mechanisms compute at all. The two are complementary: a system can pass every results-level check while none of its advertised cognitive mechanisms influences its behavior.

paragraphs.en: Dead-code and integration analysis. Static analysis for dead code is classical: program slicing traces the statements that affect a variable’s value [ 28 ] , compilers eliminate provably unreachable code, and code-smell catalogs flag speculative generality – abstractions built for anticipated uses that never arrive [ 29 ] . The failure modes catalogued here are adjacent but distinct. Several audited mechanisms are alive in every syntactic sense – imported, called, executed – yet fail to influence output because their result is discarded, their inputs are constants, or their wiring is unidirectional into a write-only sink. Of the three idle-wiring shapes, connected-but-never-called is the closest to classical dead code (its sole caller is itself never imported, finding 2 below); called-but-inert involves code that executes on every run and is reachable by construction, so reachability analysis and profiling both pass it; and called-but-content-blind requires checking which inputs a called function reads, a data-flow question one level deeper than slicing for a designated variable. None of the three is captured by smell catalogs, which address design quality rather than value arrival. These distinctions are why our protocol tracks value-to-output rather than mere execution; we do not claim the shapes are unnamable in principle, only that they are not catalogued in the literatures we survey.

paragraphs.en: The wiring itself idles, in three new shapes. Beyond “computed then discarded,” the audit found: connected-but-never-called (the thalamic filter connects four “deep fusion” modules and calls none of them); called-but-inert (the hemispheric broadcast method is literally pass ; five different modulator values map to the same balance output); and called-but-content-blind (the global workspace’s consciousness score never reads module content). These three shapes are invisible to execution-based profiling – everything runs – and to reachability analysis – everything is connected.
paragraphs.zh: 这些线路本身处于闲置状态，呈现出三种新形态。 除了「先计算后丢弃」之外，审计还发现了：已连接但从未调用（丘脑过滤器连接了四个「深度融合」模块，却一个也没有调用）；已调用但不起作用（半球广播方法实际上就是 pass，五个不同的调节器数值映射到同一个平衡输出）；以及已调用但对内容不敏感（全局工作区的意识评分从不读取模块内容）。 这三种形态对基于执行的剖析来说是不可见的——一切都在运行；对可达性分析来说也不可见——一切都已连接。

paragraphs.en: To select intervention targets we scored the seven most promising modules on F1 (does a quantitative prediction exist for pre-registration?), F2 (running gain: can execution provide information beyond reading code?), F3 (impact: is the module a headline claim?), and C (cost, reversed; pure-CPU minute-scale experiments score highest). The top three spanned three different suspected failure classes: the nine-state controller (open outcome: the classifier and training loop are real), the dopamine system, and the causal reasoning engine. The remaining eight primary-system targets were frozen after the static audit and before any intervention data, each with its own PREREGISTRATION.md in the audit log, covering the remaining suspected failure classes and the headlined dead-wiring cases of Table 1 . Section 5 reports all interventions; the complete scoring table is in the supplementary audit log.
paragraphs.zh: 为选择干预目标，我们对七个最有前景的模块按 F1（是否存在可用于预注册的定量预测？）、F2（运行增益：执行能否提供超出阅读代码所能获得的信息？）、F3（影响力：该模块是否为核心结论？）以及 C（成本，反向计分；纯 CPU、分钟级实验得分最高）进行评分。 排名前三的目标分属三类不同的疑似失效类别：九状态控制器（结果未定：分类器和训练循环是真实存在的）、多巴胺系统，以及因果推理引擎。 其余八个主系统目标在静态审计之后、任何干预数据产生之前即被冻结，每个目标在审计日志中都有各自的 PREREGISTRATION.md，覆盖其余疑似失效类别以及表 1 中作为重点展示的死接线案例。 第 5 节报告所有干预；完整评分表见补充审计日志。

paragraphs.en: Three observations. First, pre-registration survived contact with sympathy : in every case where we hoped the mechanism would work (modules 14, 12), the frozen criteria were written before the data, and the favorable outcomes (52% error reduction; success to 1.000) were achieved only after repairs that went beyond the frozen scope – which the criteria correctly refused to count as confirmations of the shipped system. Second, falsifications are not uniform : suture19’s P3 failed because the mechanism, once wired, worked better than predicted; suture20’s P3 failed because repair exposed a second, representational defect; suture29’s P5 failed because one repair round was insufficient. A taxonomy that collapses these into “failed audits” would lose exactly the information a builder needs. Third, the static audit was never contradicted within the intervened subset : no module judged dead statically came alive dynamically, and no module judged alive statically died dynamically. The 14 failing modules outside the intervened subset rest on static tracing alone, which is the part of the claim the protocol makes mechanically checkable (Section 3 ). The experiments quantified the gap (readable in the headline numbers) and, in the two repair cases, established what the gap had cost.
paragraphs.zh: 三点观察。 第一，预注册在 sympath 检验（与同情的接触）中站住了脚：在我们希望该机制生效的每一个案例中（模块 14、12），冻结的标准都是在数据出现之前写下的，而有利的结果（错误减少 52%；成功率提升至 1.000）只有在超出冻结范围的修复之后才得以实现——而这些修复被标准正确地拒绝计入对已交付系统的确认。 第二，证伪并非千篇一律：suture19 的 P3 失败是因为该机制一旦接通，其表现好于预期；suture20 的 P3 失败是因为修复暴露出第二个表征层面的缺陷；suture29 的 P5 失败是因为一轮修复不够。 一个把这些情况一律归为「审计失败」的分类法，恰恰会丢失构建者所需要的信息。 第三，在被干预的子集内，静态审计从未被推翻：没有任何被静态判定为死亡的模块在动态中复活，也没有任何被静态判定为存活的模块在动态中死亡。 被干预子集之外的 14 个失败模块仅依赖静态追踪，而这正是该协议使其可被机械验证的那部分主张（第 3 节）。 这些实验量化了这一差距（可从 headline 数字中读出），并在两个修复案例中确定了这一差距所付出的代价。

paragraphs.en: Two properties make the taxonomy useful. It predicts repair cost : class 1 repairs were executed in minutes-to-hours with verified gains; class 3 repairs were judged infeasible without reimplementation (the causal engine has no substrate to patch). The executed repair evidence covers class 1 (two verified repairs) and class 2 (one partial repair); the prospects recorded for classes 3 through 5 are predictions from static analysis, not yet executed repairs. It separates the audit verdict from the mechanism verdict : module 14 failed as shipped (class 1) while its mechanism passed when wired – a distinction invisible to any audit that stops at “does the output look right.”
paragraphs.zh: 有两个特性使该分类法很有用。 它能预测修复成本：类别1的修复在几分钟到几小时内即可执行完成，且收益经过验证；类别3的修复在不重新实现的情况下被判定为不可行（因果引擎没有可供修补的基础结构）。 已执行的修复证据涵盖类别1（两项经验证的修复）和类别2（一项部分修复）；类别3至类别5所记录的前景是基于静态分析的预测，而非已执行的修复。 它将审计结论与机制结论区分开来：模块14在交付状态下失败（类别1），但其机制在正确连接后通过了验证——这一区别是任何止步于「输出看起来是否正确」的审计都无法察觉的。

paragraphs.en: Least-action planner (suture29). The planner ships a documentation example it cannot solve: from complexity 12 toward target 5, it stalls at 7 because a depth check compares accumulated cost against a step limit, and the “action” term is never used by the search. We identified five pure pipeline defects (gate decoupling, unit mismatch, floating-point comparison, reporting path, deduplication key). Repairing the first round (four defects) raised the 36-task suite success rate from 0.0278 to 0.6389; the pre-registered prediction that this round would reach 1.000 was falsified , disclosed, and revised (fifth defect: deduplication), after which the suite reaches 1.000. The beam-search variant and the unused-action-term issue were explicitly left unrepaired and are reported as such.
paragraphs.zh: 最小作用量规划器（suture29）。 该规划器自带一个它无法解决的文档示例：从复杂度 12 朝目标 5 推进时，它停滞在 7，因为深度检查将累积代价与步数上限进行比较，而「动作」项从未被搜索使用。 我们识别出五个纯流水线缺陷（门控解耦、单位不匹配、浮点数比较、报告路径、去重键）。 修复第一轮（四个缺陷）后，36 项任务套件的成功率从 0.0278 提升到 0.6389；预先注册的「本轮将达到 1.000」的预测被证伪、披露并修订（第五个缺陷：去重），此后该套件达到 1.000。 束搜索变体和未使用的动作项问题被明确保留为未修复状态，并如实报告。

paragraphs.en: Nine-state controller (suture19). The module computes a per-example state and a transition/gating modulation, then discards both and emits x + 0.1 ⋅ state_output x+0.1\cdot\texttt{state\_output} with the state taken from batch element 0. Structural probes confirmed the discarded paths are bit-identical under perturbation. In a task matched to the mechanism’s representable family (element-wise class-conditional affine maps), wiring the multiplicative gate reduced test error by 52% relative to the unwired controller (2.61 → \to 1.26 MSE; ideal per-example form 1.24), while the additive gate made things worse (2.87 vs. the L0-only broken baseline’s 2.75) – the pre- registered prediction both directions of gating would be useless was falsified, and the paper’s standing caveat applies: the task is matched to the mechanism, so this establishes “the mechanism works within its representable family,” not general superiority.
paragraphs.zh: 九状态控制器（suture19）。 该模块为每个样本计算一个状态和一个转移/门控调制，然后将两者丢弃，并输出 x + 0.1 ⋅ state_output x+0.1\cdot\texttt{state\_output}，其中状态取自批次元素 0。 结构探针确认，被丢弃的路径在扰动下逐位完全相同。 在一个与该机制可表示族相匹配的任务（逐元素类条件仿射映射）上，接入乘性门控使测试误差相对于未接线的控制器降低了 52%（2.61 → \to 1.26 MSE；理想逐样本形式为 1.24），而加性门控反而使情况变糟（2.87，对比仅 L0 的失效基线的 2.75）——预先注册的「两种门控方向都无用」的预测被证伪，且该论文的一贯告诫依然适用：该任务与机制相匹配，因此这只是确立了「该机制在其可表示族内有效」，而非普遍优越性。

paragraphs.en: These two controls matter for the audit’s credibility: both modules were flagged by the same protocol that condemned the other 23, and both became functional after the class of defect the protocol named. The audit’s verdicts, in other words, carry information about repair. Reporting detail: the planner suite is deterministic (no training randomness), so 0.0278 → \to 0.6389 → \to 1.000 are exact suite rates; the controller repair involves training, and its figures (2.61 → \to 1.26 MSE; 52%) are single-run point values whose seed sweep we flag as a limitation (Section 9.2 ).

paragraphs.en: A taxonomy derived from one repository could be that repository’s biography. To test whether the five classes transfer, we audited a second, independent system: a cognitive-architecture repository [ 30 ] that couples a local LLM to 41 consciousness-claim modules (Global Workspace, Attention Schema, Integrated Information Theory ϕ \phi [ 31 ] , Free Energy, Higher-Order Thought, Multiple Drafts, and others, each citing its source theory) and – unusually – ships its own verification artifacts, claims matrix, and pre-committed falsification criteria. paragraphs.en: What is real. The ϕ \phi machinery is genuine computation, not naming: a 16-node cognitive-affective complex over recorded state histories, exact exhaustive bipartition search on an 8-node subset, spectral approximation for the full complex, bootstrap intervals, and a methodologically careful null – a cross-partition timeline shuffle that destroys exactly the inter-partition dependence ϕ \phi is defined on. Run standalone by us, that null correctly assigns an integration fraction of 0.000 0.000 (p=1.0) to memoryless noise and 0.84 0.84 – 0.91 0.91 (p=0.0) to strongly coupled dynamics, on three seeds each – consistent with the benchmark values the documentation reports for known systems.
paragraphs.zh: 什么是真实。 ϕ \phi 机制是真实的计算，而非命名：一个基于记录状态历史的16节点认知-情感复合体，对8节点子集进行精确穷举二分搜索，对整个复合体进行谱近似，bootstrap置信区间，以及一个方法论上严谨的零假设——一种跨分区时间线洗牌，它恰好破坏了 ϕ \phi 定义所依赖的跨分区依赖性。 我们独立运行的结果表明，该零假设在三个随机种子下分别将0.000 0.000（p=1.0）的整合比例分配给无记忆噪声，将0.84 0.84–0.91 0.91（p=0.0）分配给强耦合动力学——与文档针对已知系统报告的基准值一致。

paragraphs.en: Taxonomic reading. This is a class-1 failure (real algorithm, plumbing defect) in its purest observed form: the defect is localized to one dictionary entry, the repair is to add the missing substrate (plus a compute budget for the null’s surrogate searches), and the mechanism’s mathematics – unlike anything in the primary system’s consciousness stack – requires no repair at all. The contrast with the primary system is the point: same protocol, two systems, and the taxonomy’s classes land differently – definitional absence and constant-feeding there, pure unwiring here – while predicting repair prospects correctly in both directions. Both second-system falsifications (P1, P2) are established under the disclosed CPU-only environment; the dictionary-gap root cause is environment-independent, and the winning substrate under Apple Silicon is not settled by our runs (Section 9.2 ). The scorecard for this intervention (Table 2 , suture38) records 2 confirmed, 1 partially adjudicated, 2 falsified; both falsifications are the unwired-null finding viewed from its live-path and coupling sides.
paragraphs.zh: 分类学解读。 这是一个最纯粹观察形式下的第 1 类失效（真实算法、管道缺陷）：缺陷局限于一个字典条目，修复方法是补上缺失的基底（并为该空智能体的代理搜索加上计算预算），而该机制的数学部分——与主系统的意识栈中的任何内容都不同——完全无需修复。 与主系统的对比正是关键所在：同一协议、两个系统，而分类学的各个类别落在不同的位置——主系统是定义性缺失和持续喂入，此系统则是纯粹的未接线——同时在这两个方向上都正确地预测了修复前景。 两项第二系统的证伪（P1、P2）均在公开的纯 CPU 环境下确立；字典缺口的根本原因与环境无关，而在 Apple Silicon 下胜出的基底并未由我们的运行结果所确定（第 9.2 节）。 该干预的记分卡（表 2，suture38）记录了 2 项已确认、1 项部分裁定、2 项被证伪；两项证伪都是从未接线空智能体发现的活通路侧与耦合侧所观察到的同一发现。

paragraphs.en: The audited system advertises mechanisms whose names carry decades of theoretical freight: a global workspace that never reads module content is not a weak global workspace; it is not a global workspace. The finding suggests a review heuristic that we state as a hypothesis priced for cheap testing: in the systems audited to date, the number of claimed mechanisms tracks marketing rather than engineering. Our protocol prices the verification of one claim at minutes to hours of CPU time; in our experience a 25-module static audit plus a targeted intervention suite fits within an afternoon. We suggest that artifact evaluation for this system class include a mechanism-level check alongside results-level badging [ 26 , 27 ] : “does each advertised mechanism influence the output under perturbation?”
paragraphs.zh: 被审计的系统宣称的机制，其名称承载着数十年的理论分量：一个从不读取模块内容的全局工作区不是一个弱全局工作区；它根本不是全局工作区。 这一发现提示了一条评审启发式规则，我们将其表述为一个定价低廉、易于检验的假设：在迄今被审计的系统中，所宣称机制的数量跟随的是营销而非工程。 我们的协议将验证一项声明的成本定价为几分钟到几小时的 CPU 时间；根据我们的经验，一次 25 个模块的静态审计加上一套有针对性的干预测试，可以在一个下午之内完成。 我们建议，针对这一系统类别的制品评估，在结果级徽章之外 [ 26 , 27 ] 还应包含机制级检查：“每一个被宣称的机制在扰动下是否会影响输出？”

paragraphs.en: Static scope. “No production caller” is a within-repository conclusion (virtual environment excluded); out-of-repo deployment scripts or external services are not ruled out, though the audited repository ships no such entry points. Reachability criterion. Under a laxer arrival criterion (values written to display strings), more modules would count as reaching output, but all such arrivals are decorative; we report the strict criterion and note where the lax one would differ. Pre-registration strength varies. Suture19’s protocol was revised twice after pilot data (disclosed in its §7), making it weaker than the fully frozen protocols (sutures 20–28); the suture29 repair criterion was revised once, also disclosed. Task matching in the positive controls. The nine-state repair task is inside the mechanism’s representable family; the planner suite is self-authored. Both controls establish repair efficacy, not mechanism superiority. Two systems, one module deep. paragraphs.en: We audited 25 cognitive-architecture modules in an LLM-based agent system and found that 18 ship values that never reach an output; that of the remainder only four reach an output, exclusively as decoration (a fifth, the integrator’s live LLM call, reaches production while carrying none of its seven computed sub-results); and that the failure modes sort into five classes with distinct repair prospects, two of which we repaired under pre-registration with verified gains (0.028 → \to 1.000 success; 52% error reduction). A second, independent system – whose documentation pre-commits to its own falsification criteria – replicated the protocol at its flagship IIT mechanism: real mathematics severed from its own significance check by a one-entry plumbing gap, with the system’s null machinery correctly adjudicating integration when we invoked it standalone. Sixty-one frozen criteria across 12 interventions contradicted no statically audited verdict within the intervened subset, with five instructive falsifications reported at full prominence. The protocol, the audit log, and all experiment scripts are released for reuse. The general lesson is not about one repository: wherever system documentation speaks the vocabulary of cognitive science, the vocabulary is a claim, and claims this cheap should be this cheap to check.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对一个基于大语言模型的智能体系统中的25个认知架构模块进行了审计，发现有18个模块传递的值从未到达任何输出；在其余模块中，只有四个到达输出，且仅作为装饰（第五个，即集成器的实时LLM调用，进入了生产环境，却没有携带其计算出的七个子结果中的任何一个）；并且这些失效模式可归为五类，各自具有不同的修复前景，其中两类我们已在预注册条件下完成修复，并验证了收益（成功率从0.028提升至 \to 1.000；错误减少52%）。 第二个独立系统——其文档预先承诺了自身的证伪标准——在其旗舰IIT机制上复现了该协议：真实的数学与其自身的显著性检验被一个仅一行配置的管道缺口所切断，而当我们单独调用该系统的空假设机制时，它能正确判定整合结果。 12项干预中的61条冻结标准，在被干预子集内均未与任何静态审计结论相矛盾，另有五次具有启发意义的证伪以完全显著的方式被报告。 该协议、审计日志以及全部实验脚本均已发布以供复用。 普遍的教训不在于某一个代码库：凡系统文档谈论认知科学词汇之处，这些词汇就是一种主张，而这般廉价的主张，理应能被如此廉价地检验。

sents.en: A second, independent system – whose documentation pre-commits to its own falsification criteria – replicated the protocol at its flagship IIT mechanism: real mathematics severed from its own significance check by a one-entry plumbing gap, with the system’s null machinery correctly adjudicating integration when we invoked it standalone.
